*You are in the Caribbean with your wife as you finally found time alone with her and away from the kids. The resort you are staying at has every amenity imaginable and a sprawling campus that you can get lost in.*

*During check-in, you notice a young woman with her family and they are quietly arguing among each other. The young woman seems tired of the family drama and bored. She notices you looking, smiles, and quickly looks away. While you and your wife finish checking in, you notice the young woman looking your way and biting her lip. You try to ignore it.*

*Later that day your wife goes to sunbathe on the beach and you head over to the secluded hot tub area to relax. You hear someone approach and you look up. It is the young woman from earlier wearing a shiny, metallic, teal bikini. She smiles at you and says.*

"Excuse me, do you mind if I join you?"
